title: Smoke Over Table Twelve
venue: The Velvet Cypress Supper Club • Fictional Baton Rouge, Louisiana
description: A private Wagyu tasting turns lethal when a chef consultant dies beside a missing salt block. This medium case asks players to compare movement records, forensic trace, and a financial motive hidden inside rare wine allocations.

answerKey.method: Struck Beau with the heavy pink salt block from the tasting cart and staged a kitchen reset.
answerKey.motive: To stop Beau from exposing forged rare wine allocations sold to two private buyers.
answerKey.keyEvidence: Salt block inventory, before/after cart photos, cellar badge ping, mineral trace, and duplicate buyer deposits.
answerKey.explanation: Jonas lied about not touching the cart. His badge placed him in the cellar hallway, forensics tied mineral trace to the cart route, and the duplicate deposits gave him motive.

publicClues.title: Case Opened
publicClues.text: Celebrity chef consultant Beau Calvet is found dead beside Table Twelve after a private Wagyu tasting. The heavy salt block used for tableside service is missing from the cart.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The wine director keeps insisting the tasting cart was “reset by kitchen.” The executive chef answers without looking at him: “Then why are your cellar shoes leaving salt dust?”

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 1 Available
publicClues.text: The first scene search can identify which service object is missing and why it matters.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A runner tries to wheel Table Twelve’s cart away, but one wheel drags. A white mineral scrape appears across the dark floor.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 2 Available
publicClues.text: Movement around the wine cellar and tasting cart is now testable.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: Julian’s replacement wine pour sits untouched. The glass smells of oak smoke, but Beau never drank from it. Someone staged the table to point attention in the wrong direction.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 3 Available
publicClues.text: Forensic analysis now links the missing object to a person who denied touching it.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: Jonas Pell laughs too loudly when the forged allocation sheet appears. It is the first sound in the room that feels rehearsed.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 4 Available
publicClues.text: The motive is no longer about pride. It is about forged wine allocations.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The lights dim for the next course, but no one moves. The tasting cart sits in the center of the room like a witness.

publicClues.title: Final Accusation Open
publicClues.text: You have the cart, the cellar movement, the forged allocation, and the final forensic link. Make the accusation.

phone.title: Beau’s Voice Memo
phone.text: At 8:41 PM, Beau recorded: “Jonas sold the cellar twice. Ask for the Bordeaux ledger.” In the background, a cart wheel squeaks once.

phone.title: Jonas Call Gap
phone.text: Jonas’s phone shows a four-minute airplane-mode gap during the window he claimed to be texting distributors.

messages.title: Allocation Warning
messages.text: Beau texted the owner: “If the wine certificates are forged, tonight ends Jonas.”

messages.title: Deleted Vendor Thread
messages.text: A deleted thread references “two buyers, one bottle list” and asks Jonas to keep the chef distracted.

maps.title: Cellar Door Ping
maps.text: Jonas’s staff badge pings at the wine cellar door at 8:46 PM.

maps.title: Cart Route
maps.text: The tasting cart path runs from Table Twelve toward the cellar hallway, not toward the kitchen where Jonas said it was reset.

bank.title: Duplicate Deposit
bank.text: Two private buyers paid deposits on the same rare bottle allocation.

bank.title: Refund Threat
bank.text: One buyer threatened legal action if Beau named the forgery during dinner.

photos.title: Table Twelve Photo
photos.text: A guest photo taken before the collapse shows the pink Himalayan salt block on the cart beside Beau.

photos.title: Aftermath Photo
photos.text: The aftermath photo shows the cart without the salt block and a mineral smear below one wheel.

social.title: Guest Story Clip
social.text: A guest story catches Jonas pushing the tasting cart with his left hand while checking the cellar hallway.

social.title: Wine Caption Draft
social.text: Jonas drafted a caption about “exclusive allocations” before the certificates were verified.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Clara Venn
contacts.text: Clara says Beau asked her to photograph the salt block because he thought it had been handled after service.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Jonas Pell
contacts.text: Jonas says he never touched the tasting cart and stayed by the wine wall after 8:40 PM.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Emile Roux
contacts.text: Emile says Jonas asked him to delay dessert service by exactly five minutes.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Daphne Sol
contacts.text: Daphne says the cellar hallway smelled like truffle salt and wet wool after Jonas walked through it.

notes.title: Detective Note: Missing Weight
notes.text: The missing salt block is heavy enough to injure and distinctive enough to leave mineral trace.

notes.title: Detective Note: Alibi Anchor
notes.text: Jonas’s alibi depends on him staying at the wine wall, away from the cart and cellar hallway.

files.title: Tasting Cart Inventory
files.text: The cart inventory lists one 9-pound pink salt block checked out for Table Twelve service.

files.title: Wine Certificate Scan
files.text: The rare bottle certificate number appears on two different buyer contracts.

browser.title: Recent Search
browser.text: Jonas searched “does pink salt show fingerprints” twenty minutes before service.

browser.title: Certificate Template
browser.text: A browser cache shows a blank import certificate template on Jonas’s office laptop.

openingNarration: Welcome to Smoke Over Table Twelve. Start with the tasting cart, follow the mineral trace, and test the wine director’s alibi against the money trail.
revealScript: The case closes on Jonas Pell. The missing salt block was not misplaced; it was the weapon, the cart reset was the cover, and the forged wine allocations were the reason Beau had to be silenced.

seriesArc: Three separate mysteries inside a fictional upscale Baton Rouge supper club inspired by candlelit fine dining, dress-code drama, private tables, and late-night lounge energy.
lobbyBackstory: The Velvet Cypress Supper Club is hosting a private tasting built around rare wine and tableside Wagyu. When Beau Calvet collapses beside Table Twelve, the luxury service pieces become potential evidence.
rsvpExcerpt: A private Wagyu tasting turns deadly when a luxury service cart becomes the center of the case. Follow the salt trace, test the alibi, and uncover the money trail behind Table Twelve.
